jtechstorage.welcome.line1: ✦ Welcome to JTechStorage! You received the Storage Handbook.
jtechstorage.welcome.line2: A vanilla-friendly storage mod by %s – have fun organizing!
jtechstorage.guide.welcome.title: Welcome!
jtechstorage.guide.welcome.body:
Glad you're here! JTechStorage connects your normal chests into one network – no power, no cables. On top of that: amethyst helpers, teams and trading, phoenix mail, two bosses and gear from the End.

Turn the page for instructions and recipes.

Mod by %s
jtechstorage.guide.start.title: Getting Started
jtechstorage.guide.start.body:
1. Place a Storage Terminal.
2. Shift + right-click it with a Storage Key to link.
3. Shift + right-click chests to add them.
4. Open the terminal – done!
jtechstorage.guide.upgrades.title: Upgrades
jtechstorage.guide.upgrades.body:
Range:
%s → %s → %s → %s → %s
Ender: %s, wireless unlimited

Chests:
%s → %s → %s → %s → %s

Iron tier: only from the Amethyst Robot. Then gold, diamond, netherite.
jtechstorage.guide.sorting.title: Sorting Rules
jtechstorage.guide.sorting.body:
Hang an item frame with an item on a linked chest: it will only accept that item – and gets it first.

Multiple frames = multiple items.
jtechstorage.guide.friends.title: Team Terminal
jtechstorage.guide.friends.body:
Right-click with a bound key to link it. Name, color, access, channel messages and members.

Roles: Guest (view), Member (items), Builder (+ chests/helpers), Manager (+ upgrades, team, trade).
jtechstorage.guide.recipes.title: Recipes
jtechstorage.guide.recipes.body:
All recipes follow on the next pages.

Hover an item to see its name.

With JEI, "+" puts recipes straight into the Crafting Terminal.

jtechstorage.chel.say.10: Wow, it's so tidy in here. I'll fix that.

jtechstorage.chel.joke.3: Why does the enderman have so few friends? He can't look anyone in the eye.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.4: What does a sheep do at the gym? Wool-ups.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.5: Why was the minecart so sad? It just kept going around in circles.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.6: Two chests meet. One says: "You look full!" – "Thanks, the sprite sorted me."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.7: What's a villager without emeralds? Just a "hmmm".
jtechstorage.chel.joke.8: Why doesn't the ghast like jokes? It takes everything too hard – and then it cries.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.9: What do you call a chicken that builds redstone? A cluck comparator.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.10: Why is obsidian so cool? It used to be lava and just calmed down.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.11: What does a zombie say at sunrise? "Feeling kind of warm today … oh no."
jtechstorage.chel.joke.12: My hat is a crafting table. That's why I always have something to craft on my mind.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.13: Why doesn't the skeleton play football? It has no heart for sports – and no muscles.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.14: What does the wither say to the cow? Nothing. The wither doesn't talk to steaks.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.15: Why does the blaze never catch a cold? It's running hot all year round.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.16: What do you call a slime that never stops talking? A slimy talker.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.17: Why does Steve only build with blocks? Otherwise he'd have nothing to hold on to.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.18: What's green, sneaks up on you and says "psst"? A polite creeper. Sadly, they don't exist.
jtechstorage.chel.joke.19: A diamond for a joke? Okay. The joke is: I'm keeping the diamond.

jtechstorage.peter.say.1: With great nether stars comes great responsibility.
jtechstorage.peter.say.2: I used to craft torches. Now I craft safety.
jtechstorage.peter.say.3: My hammer is freshly polished. The zombies are welcome to stop by.
jtechstorage.peter.say.4: I'm still Chel. Just with more armor and less tripping.
jtechstorage.peter.say.5: The base is safe. The sprite says thanks.
jtechstorage.peter.say.6: Night after night I keep watch. Cookies help.
jtechstorage.peter.say.7: A hero doesn't need a cape. But he looks great in one.
jtechstorage.peter.say.8: When a creeper shows up, I just say: not here, buddy.
jtechstorage.peter.say.9: I have a joke about skeletons – but it's a bit bare-boned.

jtechstorage.guide.rest.body:
Your helpers sleep at night (the Watch Moth during the day). With resonance in the terminal they keep working – but the Spark Beetle always sleeps at night, so charge up during the day!

Peter Chel Parker never takes a break.
jtechstorage.ashley.say.1: I smell like a campfire. On purpose.
jtechstorage.ashley.say.2: Dust is just glitter that gave up.
jtechstorage.ashley.say.4: I've sneezed three times today. A record!
jtechstorage.ashley.say.5: My fur isn't dirty, it's well lived-in.
jtechstorage.ashley.say.6: Don't touch me. Okay, Peter may. He has to.
jtechstorage.ashley.say.7: I'm like a chimney – warm, dusty and a bit sooty.
jtechstorage.ashley.kicked.1: I'm not dirty, I'm all natural!
jtechstorage.ashley.kicked.3: My fur! I had just dusted myself up nicely!
jtechstorage.ashley.kicked.4: Achoo! … oh, I guess that was your healing.

jtechstorage.guide.boss.body:

jtechstorage.tutorial.skipped: Tour skipped. Shift + right-click with the guide restarts it.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.0: Hey! I'm Jbartels – I built JTechStorage. Let me quickly show you what the mod can do. (Right-click me = next, Shift + right-click = skip)
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.1: The heart of the mod is the Storage Terminal. It connects your normal vanilla chests into one network – see and take everything in one place, no power needed.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.2: With the Storage Key you bind yourself to the terminal (Shift + right-click) and add chests (Shift + right-click on the chest). While you hold it, all linked chests sparkle.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.3: The Crafting Terminal refills its grid from storage after every craft. An item frame turns a chest into a sorting chest. With the Team and Trade Terminals you share your storage with friends or open a shop.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.4: The first upgrades can't be crafted – you have to earn them! Use the Resonance Igniter and defeat the Amethyst Robot. With some luck it drops an Amethyst Core – you need one for every helper.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.5: The Wireless Terminal opens your network from afar – but only with a Wireless Core. With some luck the Amethyst Robot drops that too.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.6: The Amethyst Sprite sorts your chests by category, collects dropped items, tidies chests inside and empties placed backpacks.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.7: The Watch Moth keeps watch at night: it makes monsters glow, warns you with a bell and shows Peter his targets.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.8: The Storage Griffin is your flying mount with a chest. Land within terminal range and it unloads everything.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.9: The Spark Beetle charges your terminal with resonance. Resonance is only a bonus: more range, faster helpers – and no night break.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.10: This is Chel – named after my best friend. He crafts missing items automatically. Give him a diamond for a joke … and try a nether star.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.11: Peter Chel Parker – Chel's hero form. He protects your base from monsters.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.12: And this is Ashley. She's … well, a bit dirty. When Peter is hurt, he kicks her to heal. She (mostly) doesn't hold it against him.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.13: The Phoenix is your mail carrier: it lives in a Phoenix Nest and carries parcels from your storage straight into your friends' storage.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.14: With an Amethyst Obsidian Upgrade it becomes the Amethyst Phoenix: two seats, up to four chests. Set two stops with the Route Feather – it then shuttles back and forth on its own.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.15: Crystal Lairs float in the outer End – the Lair Compass shows the way. The Great Amethyst Spider guards them. Every victory grants an upgrade for Amethyst Obsidian gear: better than netherite, with a set bonus.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.16: Every few days the Amethyst Fox digs up an enchanted book – with crystal enchantments like Double Jump or Recall that exist nowhere else.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.17: Backpacks come in five sizes. Upgrading keeps the contents, and you can dye them, wear them on your back or place them as a block – and they pick up matching items automatically.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.18: You can recolor your helpers with dye and give them hats. And the gear button in the terminal sets the theme, accent color and size of all mod screens.
jtechstorage.tutorial.step.19: That's it! All recipes and details are in the Storage Handbook. Shift + right-click with the handbook brings me back. Have fun!

jtechstorage.guide.spider.title: End Boss: Amethyst Spider
jtechstorage.guide.spider.body:
Crystal Lairs float in the outer End. The Lair Compass (right-click in the End) points to the nearest one.

On your first visit the Great Amethyst Spider awakens (600 health): venom bite, leap, crystal webs, ground spikes, shriek. Below 50 %% she calls spiderlings.

Call again: Crystal Cocoon on the altar. Loot: exactly one upgrade per victory.
jtechstorage.guide.amethyst_obsidian.bod:
Stronger than netherite, fireproof. Smithing table: upgrade + netherite item + Crystal Obsidian (one spider upgrade per piece).

Full set: +2 hearts, Fire Resistance, Haste I and Resonance Thorns – melee attackers take crystal damage back and are slowed.

advancements.jtechstorage.amethyst_phoen: Evolve a phoenix into an Amethyst Phoenix
jtechstorage.guide.amethyst_phoenix.body:
Right-click a phoenix with an Amethyst Obsidian upgrade. Route Feather: click block A, then block B, then right-click the phoenix with it.

He shuttles between A and B, rests one night and flies back at sunrise. Right-click = mount (2 seats), jump in front = leave early. Chest = attach (up to 4). Sneak + right-click = menu (chests, sit mode). More cargo = slower.

jtechstorage.guide.fox.title: Amethyst Fox
jtechstorage.guide.fox.body:
Place the fox and link it with a bound key. About every three days it digs in dirt, sand or gravel during the day and finds an enchanted book with a crystal enchantment – available nowhere else. The book goes into your storage.

Feeding speeds it up: glow berries −6 h, sweet berries −3 h (up to 4× per day). Sneak + right-click with an empty hand = pack up.
jtechstorage.guide.crystal_enchants.body:
Double Jump (boots, I–II): jump again in mid-air.
Sprint (leggings, I–III): faster while sprinting.
Recall (storage key): right-click into the air to return to the terminal once per day.
Careful Touch (pickaxe): mines monster spawners with their mob and budding amethyst.
Life Spark (sword/axe, I–III): melee hits heal you a little.

Only from the Amethyst Fox, apply with an anvil.

jtechstorage.guide.terminal.title: Using the Terminal
jtechstorage.guide.terminal.body:
Left click: stack · Right click: half · Shift-click: to inventory. Click with an item in hand: store it.

Search: name, enchantment (e.g. "sharpness v"), $enchantment, @mod, #tag. Right-click the search box to clear it.

Crafting Terminal: the grid refills from storage, "×" empties it. Wireless Terminal (with Wireless Core): Shift + right-click the terminal to bind, then right-click in the air.
jtechstorage.guide.interface.title: Interface
jtechstorage.guide.interface.body:
The gear button in the terminal (below the upgrade slots) opens the settings for all mod screens:

light or dark theme, accent color, terminal height (4–10 rows or auto) and item count size.
